build.description: Default OpenCode build agent configured as a host-project implementer with agent-wiki context and memory handoff rules.

wiki-curator.description: Maintains compact project memory in agent-wiki/wiki and structured registries in agent-wiki/knowledge.

contextualize.description: Load compact agent-wiki context for the current host-agent task.
contextualize.template:
Use this compact agent-wiki context pack for the current host-agent task:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/contextualize.py --role implementer --project-root . --max-lines 180 $ARGUMENTS`

Restate the user's task in the current project context, choose the smallest relevant route from ROUTING_TABLE.md, and open only the files needed for that route.

context-curator.description: Load the agent-wiki curator context pack.
context-curator.template:
Use this agent-wiki curator context pack as startup context:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/contextualize.py --role wiki-curator --project-root . --no-git --max-lines 180`

Review only routed evidence and keep agent-wiki/wiki compact.

wiki-lint.description: Run the agent-wiki lint gate and explain failures.
wiki-lint.template:
Run and interpret the agent-wiki lint gate:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/lint.py`

If it fails, explain the exact issue and propose or apply the smallest fix.

wiki-scan.description: Record a curator handoff from current host-project git changes.
wiki-scan.template:
Record and summarize a Git-aware curator handoff. Pass optional args through, for example --truth-impact no --evidence path --verification 'pytest passed'.

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/scan_changes.py --project-root . --summary 'OpenCode wiki-scan handoff.' $ARGUMENTS`

Explain which routes the curator should inspect, what evidence or verification was recorded, and whether current truth may have changed.

wiki-review-next.description: Load the next pending curator handoff.
wiki-review-next.template:
Load the next pending agent-wiki handoff for curator review:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/handoff_queue.py --project-root . next`

Inspect only the routed evidence needed to decide whether compact truth or registries should change. Leave uncertainty in OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.

wiki-watch.description: Show the latest handoff wake-up event and watcher instructions.
wiki-watch.template:
Show the latest safe handoff wake-up event:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/watch_handoffs.py --project-root . --once --no-bell`

For a persistent watcher in a separate terminal, run: python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/watch_handoffs.py --project-root .

wiki-map.description: Regenerate agent-wiki/wiki/PROJECT_MAP.md from the host project tree.
wiki-map.template:
Regenerate the host-project map and summarize structural changes:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/build_tree.py --project-root .`

Then inspect agent-wiki/wiki/PROJECT_MAP.md if needed and note whether routing should change.

wiki-rollover.description: Check active wiki logs for rollover.
wiki-rollover.template:
Check active logs for rollover:

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/rollover_logs.py --threshold 800`

If rollover is needed, summarize which logs should close or archive.

wiki-inject-rules.description: Inject agent-wiki memory rules into host OpenCode agents. Pass --agent/--exclude args if needed.
wiki-inject-rules.template:
Inject agent-wiki memory rules into host agents. If $ARGUMENTS is empty, inject into all non-curator host agents. If arguments are provided, pass them through.

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/inject_host_agent_rules.py --project-root . $ARGUMENTS`

Summarize which agents now respect project memory rules.

wiki-check-rules.description: Check whether selected/default host agents include agent-wiki memory rules.
wiki-check-rules.template:
Check host-agent memory-rule injection status. If $ARGUMENTS is empty, check all non-curator host agents.

!`python agent-wiki/scripts/wiki/check_host_agent_rules.py --project-root . $ARGUMENTS`

If any agents are missing rules, explain how to inject all agents or selected agents.
